cases.falsifying_expectation: Any offered or taken copy choice for Clone in this ordering contradicts H01-A. Any post-Humility 2/2 Bear state contradicts H01-A. A retained Bear-copy identity after Humility leaves contradicts H01-A.
cases.initial_ordering: Humility is on the battlefield before Clone enters. Clone is cast (or otherwise enters) while the pre-existing Humility continuous effect applies.
cases.post_humility_discriminating_state: If Humility leaves the battlefield afterward, Clone returns to its printed 0/0 characteristics and dies to the applicable state-based action (toughness 0 or less). It is NOT a 2/2 Bear.
rules_authority_refs: CR 614.12 (entry-replacement applicability considers already-existing continuous effects)
CR 614.12a (choices only where an applicable entering-replacement requires one; none does here)
CR 613.1a/613.1f/613.1g, 613.4b, 613.7 (layer ordering, conditional on a copy identity existing)
Meddling Mage under Humility Q&A precedent (same 614.12 shape)
cases.supersedes: RQ-C3-H01 expected_rules_events step 2 (COPY_CHOICE under pre-existing Humility) and the old external decision script copy-choices entry
cases.visible_state_under_humility: Clone on the battlefield as Clone (not a copy of anything): 1/1 with no abilities. NOTE: visibly identical to the incorrect copy-then-Humility path, hence non-discriminating alone.

cases.expected_copy_choice: enter as copy of Runeclaw Bear
cases.falsifying_expectation: Absence of the copy decision at entry contradicts H01-B. Loss of Bear-copy identity after Humility leaves (e.g. reverting to printed Clone 0/0) contradicts H01-B.
cases.initial_ordering: Clone enters while no Humility exists, copying Runeclaw Bear. Humility enters (or begins applying to Clone) only afterward.
cases.post_humility_discriminating_state: After Humility leaves, the permanent remains the Bear copy and is 2/2 (Runeclaw Bear characteristics).
rules_authority_refs: CR 707.2 (copy effects; layer 1 copy before Humility layers 6/7b)
CR 613.1a/613.1f/613.1g, 613.4b, 613.7 (copy layer 1 applies before ability-removal/P-T-setting regardless of timestamps)
CR 614.12 (copy replacement applicable: no suppressing pre-existing effect at entry)
cases.visible_state_under_humility: 1/1 with no abilities (Bear-copy identity retained underneath Humility).

cases.copied_identity: chosen battlefield creature (scenario default: Runeclaw Bear)
cases.expected_copy_choice: enter as copy of the chosen creature
cases.falsifying_expectation: Suppression of the copy decision contradicts H01-C. Entry as a non-copy 0/0 Clone with no Humility involvement contradicts H01-C.
cases.initial_ordering: No Humility is involved at any point. Clone enters and copies a creature on the battlefield normally.
cases.post_humility_discriminating_state: Not applicable (no Humility). The permanent remains the chosen copy with that creature's copiable characteristics as modified by layer 1.
rules_authority_refs: Oracle text of Clone: 'You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield.'
